seminar: A Guide to Statistical Network Modeling

base_panels.name: Knecht Dutch classroom friendship panel
base_panels.source: University of Oxford SIENA tutorial / public klas12b release
base_panels.network_type: Directed binary friendship nominations; four observed waves.
base_panels.support_rule: The app retains only actors present in every selected wave; it does not convert pupil absence into a non-tie.
base_panels.limit: The panel has documented missing nominations/attributes and a composition change; coevolution estimates are model-based associations, not causal peer effects.

base_panels.name: RSiena s50 friendship teaching panel
base_panels.network_type: Directed binary friendship nominations; three observed waves.
base_panels.support_rule: All 50 actors are retained across the three supplied waves.
base_panels.limit: The source documents s50 as a numerical teaching excerpt rather than a properly delineated population network.

base_panels.name: Teenage Friends and Lifestyle Study — full Glasgow panel
base_panels.source: University of Oxford SIENA full Glasgow release
base_panels.network_type: Directed friendship nominations; three observed waves; the response is binary friendship presence, combining source codes 1=best friend and 2=just friend.
base_panels.support_rule: The network-only workflow uses the documented 129-actor all-wave selection and never turns the source's structural-absence code 10 into a non-tie. A coevolution workflow further retains only those selected actors with the stated behavior observed at every selected wave; the app displays that exclusion count.
base_panels.limit: One school-cohort setting with documented composition information; modeled selection and influence do not independently establish causal peer effects.

base_panels.name: Coleman high-school friendship panel
base_panels.network_type: Directed binary friendship nominations; Fall 1957 and Spring 1958 observations.
base_panels.support_rule: The app retains only actors present at both observed waves.
base_panels.limit: Two waves identify only one observation interval and the public release has no verified repeated actor behavior.

base_panels.name: Correlates of War formal-alliance annual panel, 1960–1970
base_panels.source: Correlates of War Formal Alliances v4.1
base_panels.network_type: Annual undirected binary treaty-presence snapshots constructed from documented alliance and state-system records.
base_panels.support_rule: The app uses states present at every selected annual endpoint; state entry and exit are excluded rather than coded as non-ties.
base_panels.limit: This is a transparently constructed annual panel; within-year ordering, treaty mechanism, and causal geopolitical interpretation are not observed.
